description: [DREAL OCCITANIE] Barrages de canaux concédés et autorisés de classe A, B et C en Occitanie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.picto-occitanie.fr. Identification of authorised and granted dams in Occitanie, class A, B and C according to Decree No. 2007-1735 of 11 December 2007 on the Safety of Hydraulic Works and the Standing Technical Committee on Dams and Hydraulic Works and amending the Environmental Code. By Decree No 2015-526 of 12 May 2015, this classification will change. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL OCCITANIA] Class A, B and C Class A, B and C licensed channel dams in Occitania" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
